seo_description: Promote Waipu is a non-profit community group with all proceeds from our activities fed directly back into the local Waipu community.
who_lead: Promote Waipu, officially known as Waipu Business and Community Inc, is a non-profit community group with all proceeds from our activities fed directly back into the Waipu community.
who_body:
Our committee is made up of passionate business people and local residents all with a strong community spirit. While we do have our own range of entertaining events — such as the ever-popular Christmas Eve Street Parade, five massive Street & Park Markets throughout the year, and the Winter in Waipu programme throughout July — we pride ourselves on being the only local organisation focused on supporting and promoting the entire Waipu community.

We also successfully manage and/or support local beautification projects and have good lines of communication with local bodies and Government Agencies. Our ultimate goal is to assist in promoting Waipu as the most desirable place to live, work and play!

Promote Waipu actively encourages community participation — by volunteering at local events, becoming a Promote Waipu business member (our base website listing is free to all Waipu-based businesses), or joining our friendly committee. We'd love you to be part of our wider family!
community_lead: Just 90 minutes north of Auckland and 30 minutes south of Whangarei, Waipu is situated on one of the most stunning coastlines in New Zealand.
community_body:
With a population of around 3,000, Waipu welcomes visitors with its uniquely friendly, charming and laid-back lifestyle. Come summer time, holiday-makers flock to experience iconic Kiwi beaches, cafes, restaurants and specialty shops — loving it just as much as we do!

Waipu is rich in Scottish history and plays host to many annual events including the New Year's Day Highland Games and the Winter in Waipu Tartan Festival month. It has a thriving events calendar with the ever popular Street Markets, Easter Carnival and famous Christmas Eve Street Parade, which always draws a spectacular crowd.
cta_body: All profits of Promote Waipu membership and website listings are used to promote Waipu and support local community events.
